SymbolicEssence.ArchetypalFunction: Primordial chaos goddess embodying the salt sea, creative/destructive mother, and undifferentiated potential before cosmic order
SymbolicEssence.SymbolicCore: The chaos waters from which all emerges and to which all returns

Correspondences.Color: Deep Blue-Black, Storm Gray, Foam White

DevelopmentalArc: Primordial Unity → Maternal Creation → Disturbance by Children → Vengeful Rage → Combat → Death → Cosmic Matter

MythicAppearances: Creation of cosmos from her corpse
CulturalContext.ReligiousOrRitualUse: Represented in New Year festivals as chaos overcome by order, symbolic of primordial state before creation
CulturalContext.HistoricalEvolution: Likely personification of actual sea, evolved into mythological chaos monster, represents older matriarchal/chaotic forces overcome by patriarchal order

SymbolicRepresentation.ImageryNotes: Depicted as massive dragon/serpent, primordial ocean personified, mother of monsters, often shown in combat with Marduk, split body becomes heaven and earth
SymbolicRepresentation.PoeticInvocation: I am the salt deep before creation, the mother whose body becomes the world, the chaos that gives birth to order through death.
SymbolicRepresentation.DreamForm: Dissolving into vast dark waters with no bottom or surface; being swallowed by the ocean itself; formless potential before differentiation

MetaIntegration.RitualFunction: Invoke for accessing primordial chaos, creative destruction, return to undifferentiated state, facing the abyss
AIPromptSeeds: Generate a primordial force that must be defeated for creation to occur, whose body becomes the ordered cosmos.
Create the original mother whose children must slay her to establish their own order.
NarrativeHooks: Slaying the dragon to create the world
